name: MEDIC
description: MEDIC is a comprehensive evaluation framework for assessing large language models in clinical applications, measuring safety and utility across multiple clinical dimensions including operational capabilities and hallucination rates without reliance on reference texts.
reputation: Includes a public leaderboard on Hugging Face, indicating community adoption.
notes: Highlights knowledge-execution gap and safety trade-offs in clinical LLMs; uses a novel Cross-Examination Framework.
